shortcut_probes.strategy: For a printed quadratic term, integrate only the constant; among the matching linear terms choose largest magnitude power coefficient. Never calculate the quadratic antiderivative.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Baseline averages uniform choice among the 2 or 3 constant-matched options, after granting correct constant integration. Fresh success 30/35 versus 0.395 baseline; exact assignment-domain success 66/84 versus 5/12 baseline. This partial predictor bypasses integration of the nonconstant summand; counterexamples are retained and the heuristic is not claimed perfect.
